name: Salma Saldean
summary: At Saldean's Farm, Salma Saldean keeps a welcome place for travelers. She and her husband, Farmer Saldean, tend the homestead in Westfall, where bandits threaten the farms and Stormwind has left the region. She offers meals in return for help around the farm.

sections.title: Hospitality in a Hard Land
sections.body: Salma Saldean welcomes travelers to a farm that has endured where neighboring homesteads have burned or fallen to the Defias Brotherhood. A hearty pot waits on the stove, and she looks for capable hands to help around the farmstead.

sections.title: Putting Food on the Table
sections.body: Salma feeds her family and visitors with what Westfall provides. She teaches travelers to make Goretusk liver pie and Westfall stew with wild boar, vultures, murlocs, and stray okra.

faq.answer: Salma Saldean farms at Saldean's Farm in central Westfall with her husband. She feeds and comforts travelers while trying to keep the farm running amid the region's collapse.
Salma can be found outside her farmhouse at Saldean's Farm, along the road in central Westfall, just north of the crossroads leading toward Sentinel Hill.

faq.q: What recipes does Salma Saldean teach?
faq.answer: Salma teaches travelers to make Goretusk Liver Pie and Westfall Stew with ingredients from Westfall's wildlife.

faq.q: Why is it so hard for the Saldeans to find help?
faq.answer: Finding help is hard because farmers and laborers have fled marauding bandits, rogue harvest golems, and Stormwind's absent royal army. The few homesteaders who remain are short-handed.

faq.q: How do the Saldeans survive the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: The Saldeans rely on passing adventurers and their own resilience to defend their property. Though danger surrounds them, they refuse to leave their land and home.
Salma is married to Farmer Saldean, who works alongside her to deal with malfunctioning harvest watchers and rogue beasts.

angles.text: Salma Saldean offers cooks traveling through Westfall practical recipes, including Westfall Stew and Goretusk Liver Pie, made with local wildlife.
Salma shows the stubborn resolve of Alliance homesteaders who hold on to their livelihoods despite the Crown's neglect.
As a human traveler, Salma's farm offers a glimpse of the hardship Stormwind's common folk face beyond the capital's fortified walls.
